<?php
function null94() { yield 0 => null; }
function bool94() { yield 0 => true; }
function float94() { yield 0 => 1.5; }
function string94() { global $s; yield 0 => $s; }
function warningScalar94($level,$message) { echo "W;"; return true; }
function sinkScalar94(&$x) {
    if ($x === null) { echo "N;"; }
    elseif ($x === true) { echo "B;"; }
    elseif ($x === 1.5) { echo "F;"; }
    elseif ($x === "ab") { echo "S;"; }
    else { echo "BAD;"; }
    $x = "changed";
}
$s="a"; $s.="b"; set_error_handler('warningScalar94');
sinkScalar94(...null94()); sinkScalar94(...bool94());
sinkScalar94(...float94()); sinkScalar94(...string94());
echo "V:",$s,";"; unset($s);
purpose: Core identity checks distinguish all scalar cache types; a mutated fresh sink cell leaves the runtime string source unchanged
